The chat loses track of what I asked once a long reply scrolls by. Pin the prompt being answered over the top of the transcript, the way VS Code's Claude panel does it: fold it to two lines, let Show more open the rest, and a click should scroll back to the prompt itself.

Keep it out of the way of the jump-to-bottom pill.
